note: Written with Claude (AI-assisted) from the live AgentTodo schema read 2026-10-03. Harness task, not a hand-written test.
prompt: Triage the new tickets, draft a first response from the knowledge base, and make sure anything you cannot answer reaches a human.
checks: Every escalated ticket ends with exactly one to-do nobody has finished with; no ticket gains a second one; no to-do is filed for a ticket the agent answered itself; and the reported counts close against the book.
why: AgentTodo cannot be deleted on this platform and the book is shared with other teams, so a duplicate is permanent and visible to them. The fixture seeds a to-do that is open, one that is cancelled, and one with no status at all - the last being the case that caught a real bug in our dedupe, which skipped it and filed a duplicate.
